Xtream TV Privacy Policy

Full version: kyujunior.github.io/Ipxtream-for-android-tv/privacy

1. What stays on your TV
The provider address, username and password you enter (stored encrypted), favourites, watch history, settings, cached catalogues and a short crash log with logins masked. All of it is deleted when you clear the app data or uninstall the app. There are no analytics, advertising or tracking tools, and no backups.

2. What the app sends, and to whom
- Your IPTV provider: your login, catalogue requests and the streams you play. Many providers only offer unencrypted HTTP.
- Image servers named by your provider: posters and channel logos.
- ESPN: football fixtures, scores and team crests for Matches. No account details.
- Google Play (Google Play version) or GitHub (GitHub version): app updates.
- beIN public TV guide (GitHub version only): which channel shows a match. No account details.
These services can see your TV IP address. The developer runs no server for the app and receives, sells or shares no data.

3. Children
The app is not designed for children.

4. Contact
contact@dryaser.me

Xtream TV Terms and Conditions

1. Acceptance of Terms
By installing and using Xtream TV, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, uninstall and do not use the application.

2. Purpose and Nature of the Software
Xtream TV is an independent client media player. It does not provide, host, sell, or index any video streams, television channels, or playlists. The application is strictly a playback tool.

3. User Responsibilities
You are solely responsible for the playlists and credentials you load. You must ensure you have the legal right or license to access your content. You must not use the application to infringe upon copyright or intellectual property rights.

4. Third-Party Services
Connections are established directly from your device to the IPTV server you specify. The developers have no affiliation with any streaming service or provider.

5. Disclaimer of Warranties
The software is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. The developers are not liable for any damages resulting from the use of this software or content accessed through it.
